rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for supernatural or magical qualities.

example.english: This magic talisman is truly supernatural; it lights up by itself at night.
example.traditional: 呢部法器真係神奇，夜晚會自己發光。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 faat3 hei3 zan1 hai6 san4 kei4 je5 maan5 wui5 zi6 gei2 faat3 gwong1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for ritual or supernatural magic, especially in fantasy contexts.

example.english: This magic can summon a fire dragon.
example.traditional: 呢套魔法可以召喚出火龍。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 mo4 faat3 ho2 ji5 ziu6 wun6 ceot1 fo2 lung4

rows.note: Use this for a wonderful or magical-feeling result or moment rather than a supernatural property.

example.english: That moment was pure magic; everyone singing together made me cry.
example.traditional: 嗰一刻真係奇妙，成班人一齊唱歌搞到我喊咗出嚟。
example.jyutping: go2 jat1 hak1 zan1 hai6 kei4 miu6 sing4 baan1 jan4 jat1 cai4 coeng3 go1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for stage magic involving conjuring tricks and illusions.

example.english: Look, they used magic to make the handkerchief disappear!
example.traditional: 你睇，佢用魔術將隻手帕變走喇！
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 keoi5 jung6 mo4 seot6 zoeng1 zek3 sau2 paa3 bin3 zau2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “magic” means supernatural power or a mysterious force that produces an effect or attraction.

example.english: This song has a kind of magic that makes people listen to it again and again.
example.traditional: 呢首歌有種魔力，令人一聽再聽。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 jau5 zung2 mo4 lik6 ling6 jan4 jat1 teng1 zoi3 teng1

rows.note: Use this for the enchanting personal appeal or charm slice of “magic,” rather than literal supernatural power.

example.english: The way he speaks has such magic that the whole room goes quiet.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢好有魅力，成間房都靜晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 mei6 lik6 seng4 gaan1 fong2 dou1 zing6 saai3
